name_zh: 昂山/昂山素季/缅甸佛教：佛教民族主义与民主斗争
name_en: Aung San/Suu Kyi/Myanmar Buddhism: Buddhist Nationalism & Democratic Struggle
description_zh: 缅甸昂山 (1915-1947) 独立建国之父/昂山素季 (1945-) 诺贝尔和平奖/1988-2021 民主斗争/2015-2021 文官政府/2021 政变/军政府/罗兴亚危机/佛教民族主义(马巴塔/维拉图)/2024 内战升级。核心张力：佛教民族主义(种族/宗教/领土/巴利语/僧伽/巴干遗产)vs 民族民主(联邦/少数民族/人权/国际法)vs 军队政治(塔马道/国防服务/宪法 2008/25%席位)。体现 M196 佛教民族主义 — 以"巴利语正统+僧伽政治+种族净化+军队共生"四位一体，在殖民/冷战/军统/民主/内战六重历史断层中构建佛教民族国家。
description_en: Myanmar Aung San (1915-1947) independence father/Aung San Suu Kyi (1945-) Nobel Peace Prize/1988-2021 democratic struggle/2015-2021 civilian govt/2021 coup/military junta/Rohingya crisis/Buddhist nationalism (MaBaTha/Wirathu)/2024 civil war escalation. Core tensions: Buddhist nationalism (race/religion/territory/Pali/Sangha/Pagan legacy) vs ethnic democracy (federal/minorities/human rights/international law) vs military politics (Tatmadaw/Defense Services/2008 Constitution/25% seats). Exemplifies M196 Buddhist Nationalism — quaternity of 'Pali orthodoxy + Sangha politics + ethnic cleansing + military symbiosis' constructing Buddhist nation-state amid six historical ruptures of colonial/Cold War/military rule/democracy/civil war.
reason_zh: 缅甸非单纯佛教国家，而是"佛教正统+军队+种族"三位一体民族主义国家。昂山以军队建国，军队以佛教/种族凝聚合法性，素季以佛教/非暴力/民主挑战军队。M196 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(伊朗)、M150 塔木德(犹太)、M160 正教(塞尔维亚)，核心在于"上座部佛教即国家意识形态+僧伽即政治动员+军队即佛教守护者"的东南亚佛教民族主义范式。
reason_en: Myanmar not mere Buddhist state but 'Buddhist orthodoxy + military + ethnicity' trinity nationalist state. Aung San built state via military, military uses Buddhism/ethnicity for legitimacy, Suu Kyi challenged military via Buddhism/non-violence/democracy. M196 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (Iran), M150 Talmudic (Jewish), M160 Orthodox (Serbia), core: 'Theravada Buddhism as state ideology + Sangha as political mobilization + military as Buddhism guardian' Southeast Asian Buddhist nationalism paradigm.
steps_zh: 上座部佛教即国家意识形态：巴利语经典/僧伽/布施/戒/禅/智/国王护法/佛教即合法性/巴干千寺遗产
僧伽政治动员与马巴塔：维拉图/969运动/马巴塔/反穆斯林/罗兴亚/种族清洗/僧侣街头/政治施压/军队默许
军队佛教共生与塔马道：国防服务/宪法 2008 第 25%席位/佛教捐赠/僧侣特权/军队即国家/佛教即民族/种族即公民权
昂山素季非暴力/民主/诺奖/2015 大选/文官政府/罗兴亚沉默/国际法庭/2021 政变/入狱/绝食/抵抗象征
2024 内战升级与联邦民主：人民保卫军/民族团结政府/少数民族武装/联邦宪法草案/国际支持/佛教民族主义瓦解/多元联邦重构
steps_en: Theravada Buddhism as state ideology: Pali canon/Sangha/dana/sila/samadhi/panna/king as protector/Buddhism as legitimacy/Pagan thousand temples heritage
Sangha political mobilization & MaBaTha: Wirathu/969 movement/MaBaTha/anti-Muslim/Rohingya/ethnic cleansing/monks streets/political pressure/military acquiescence
Military-Buddhism symbiosis & Tatmadaw: Defense Services/2008 Constitution 25% seats/Buddhist donations/monk privileges/military = state/Buddhism = nation/ethnicity = citizenship
Suu Kyi non-violence/democracy/Nobel/2015 election/civilian govt/Rohingya silence/ICJ/2021 coup/imprisoned/hunger strike/resistance symbol

2024 civil war escalation & federal democracy: People's Defense Forces/National Unity Govt/ethnic armed orgs/federal constitution draft/international support/Buddhist nationalism crumbling/federal pluralism reconstruction
expected_zh: 以"上座部正统+僧伽动员+军队共生+种族净化"四位一体，在六重历史断层中构建佛教民族国家，留下民主斗争/种族灭绝/联邦重构的悲剧与希望交织遗产。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'Theravada orthodoxy + Sangha mobilization + military symbiosis + ethnic cleansing' constructs Buddhist nation-state amid six historical ruptures, leaving intertwined legacy of democratic struggle/genocide/federal reconstruction.
